purpose: Test depth profile and task-family generality of frozen PreCap-v9, independently from v1b/v2.
pairing: Same task, depth, seed, initialization and train/test sampling stream across activations.
primary_gate: On legacy_core tasks, at least 2/3 task-level medians must be < 0 against both SiLU and GELU, with no higher PreCap bad-rate.
depth_question: Report effects by each depth 4/8/16/32/64; no claim that benefit grows with depth unless the pre-specified trend is observed across core tasks.
exclusions: No parameter, formula, task, seed, optimizer, training-step, or gate changes after launch. New-task results are reported separately from the primary core-task decision.
